header._note_DO_NOT_TRANSLATE_lang_aria_keys: The four lang_*_aria keys above (lang_en_current_aria, lang_bg_current_aria, lang_switch_to_en_aria, lang_switch_to_bg_aria) are consumed IMPLICITLY by the i18n plugin (scripts/i18n-plugin.js) — the plugin string-constructs the key names per-emit from a segment's data-lang plus its is-active state. They will appear as ORPHAN in `npm run i18n:lint` output because no HTML data-i18n attribute references them. DO NOT DELETE them thinking they're unused. This _note key itself is also orphan by design; leave it here as future-editor guidance. This note key's value is kept identical across all locales — do NOT translate it, or a future dev reading a translated identifier list will not be able to grep for the identifiers in code.

meta.title: Vayana Bungalows — Boutique Bungalows in Tsarevo, Bulgaria
meta.description: Vayana Bungalows: a boutique bungalow retreat on the Black Sea coast in Tsarevo, Bulgaria — handcrafted hospitality, garden views, and quiet days.
meta.og_description: A boutique bungalow retreat on the Black Sea coast in Tsarevo, Bulgaria — handcrafted hospitality, garden views, and quiet days.

hero.subtitle: Where the pines meet the coast and the days run on tide and appetite.

cta_strip.title: Choose your bungalow, then book your stay.
cta_strip.body: Twenty-eight villas across the island, each with its own character. Pick the one that calls you.

intro.title: On the Black Sea coast, at the edge of the Strandzha forest.
intro.body_para1: Vayana Bungalows is a small family-run retreat in Tsarevo, Bulgaria — a handful of hardwood bungalows tucked between the pines and the sea, hand-built and run with the same care we'd put into our own home.
intro.body_para2: Our guests come for the quiet, the daybreak swims, and the kind of unhurried hospitality that you remember long after the drive back.

locations.title: One of the world's most desirable locations.
locations.spa_body: Open-air pavilions, salt-water plunge pools, and treatments built around the island's botanicals.
locations.activities_body: Reef snorkeling at first light, sunset paddleboards, guided hikes to the volcanic crater rim.
locations.dine_body: Three restaurants from a single kitchen garden. Black Sea seafood, wood fire, no menu after seven.

cta_block.title: Stay four nights, the fifth is on us.
cta_block.body: An invitation to slow down, between June and September, in any of our bungalows.

testimonial.quote: “The kind of place where the days run on tide and appetite, and the staff seem to know what you need before you do.”

services.title: All the essentials for a cozy and comfortable stay.
services.airport_body: Boat transfer included with every stay.
services.wifi_body: Fibre across the island, even on the beach.
services.laundry_body: Same-day pressing, hand-care for delicate fabrics.
services.breakfast_body: Tropical fruit, pressed juice, and pastries before sunrise.
services.pool_body: Three pools, including a fifty-metre lap at the beach club.
